args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy release, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service is now healthy with error rate 0.002. trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Rollback:** I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east updated before the orchestrator halted), so I retried and the rollback completed successfully across all regions. The service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") documenting the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged. Note that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation — v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until that's resolved.
